security: ERP user admin (apps/erp/src/features/admin/adminApi.ts plus the users screen): new 403 FORBIDDEN details.reason values to show as messages. SCOPE_ESCALATION now also comes from PATCH /users/:id, POST /users/:id/{reset-password,deactivate,activate,unlock} and PUT /users/:id/scope when a project-scoped admin targets an all-projects or other-project account. SUPER_ADMIN_TARGET now also comes from POST /users and PATCH /users/:id when a non-Super-Admin assigns the Super Admin role. SELF_CHANGE now also comes from POST /users/:id/reset-password on one's own id. Hide the 'Reset password' action on the current user's own row and point to Change password instead.

ERP and portal login screens (staff POST /api/v1/auth/login and /auth/login/mfa; portal POST /api/v1/portal/auth/login): handle 429 RATE_LIMITED (details.retry_after, Retry-After header) by showing 'Too many attempts, try again in a moment'. It now also comes back when parallel attempts exceed the lockout budget. Disable the submit button while a request is in flight.

ERP customer bulk portal enable (CustomersPage.tsx, POST /api/v1/customers/portal/bulk-enable): the response gains an optional `failed: int` (absent when 0). Response shape {dry_run, enabled, already_enabled, failed?, credentials: [{customer_id, customer_code, full_name, phone, temporary_password, temp_password(deprecated)}]}. When failed > 0, show 'N customers were not enabled; run bulk enable again'. Contract: packages/contracts/src/modules/customers.ts PortalBulkEnableResponseSchema.

ERP customer 360 / KYC panel: PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id that changes PAN or Aadhaar on a SUBMITTED or VERIFIED customer now returns kyc_status=PENDING with kyc_submitted_by/kyc_verified_by = null. Warn the user before saving such an edit ('Changing PAN/Aadhaar will reset KYC to Pending') and refresh the KYC badge from the response.
ERP co-applicant add/remove on an erased customer now returns 422 BUSINESS_RULE details.rule=CUSTOMER_ERASED. Hide those actions when customer.erased_at is set.
money: ERP booking wizard, POST /api/v1/bookings: new optional body field price_deviation_reason (ReasonSchema). If agreement_value_paise differs from the flat's price_paise, the API answers 422 BUSINESS_RULE with details {rule:'PRICE_DEVIATION_NOT_ALLOWED', field:'agreement_value_paise', list_price_paise, agreement_value_paise, deviation_paise, needs:['agreement.edit permission' | 'price_deviation_reason']}. StepAgreement must lock the value for users without agreement.edit and, for users with it, require a reason field whenever value ≠ list price. If the price changed underneath, refetch the flat.
GET /api/v1/bookings/:id (BookingDetailResponse) now carries list_price_paise (nullable), price_deviation_reason and price_deviation_by. Show the deviation on Booking 360.

GET /api/v1/bookings returns compact BookingRow by default: no flat_snapshot, block_id, cash/account_agreed (read summary.cash/account.agreed_paise instead), schedule-derived summary.next_installment, parking, sales user or completion fields; plan_snapshot is {name} only. Pass ?view=full for every field. CSV is always full.

Booking wizard: POST /api/v1/flats/:id/reserve {minutes: 1–30, default 15} (permission booking.create) returns FlatRow; repeating it extends the hold. 409 FLAT_NOT_AVAILABLE carries details {flat_id, current_status, hold_by_user_id, hold_until}. POST /api/v1/flats/:id/release {reason?} (holder or settings.manage; anyone for a lapsed hold) returns FlatRow, or 422 BUSINESS_RULE rule NOT_ON_HOLD, or 403. Reserve on flat pick and release on wizard cancel. The grid already shows lapsed holds as AVAILABLE.
PUT /api/v1/booking-drafts: the ERP must generate a uuid id when the wizard starts and send it on every autosave; the server upserts by (id, user). Another user's id returns 404.

409 PLAN_STAGES_MISSING can now come from POST /blocks, PATCH /blocks/:id (stage_sequence), POST /blocks/:id/stage-sequence, PATCH /masters/payment-plans/:id (installments) and PATCH /payment-plan-assignments/:id. details.missing_stages is [{id, name, block_id, block_name, plan_id, plan_name, assignment_id}] (plan_id / plan_name / assignment_id are absent on the assignment-create path). The NEW details.stranded_bookings is [{booking_id, booking_number, installment_seq, installment_name, stage_id|null, stage_name|null}]. The ERP stage-sequence editor and plan editor should list both.
POST /bookings/:id/complete returns 409 HANDOVER_BLOCKED with details {problems[], unraised_installments:[{seq,name}], cash_short_paise, account_short_paise}. Show the list in the handover dialog.

POST /payments/:id/reverse on a COMPLETED booking: 409 BOOKING_COMPLETED (details {status, permission:'settings.manage'}) for normal users. For settings.manage holders the booking reopens (ACTIVE, flat BOOKED), so the ERP should refetch the booking and warn before reversing on a COMPLETED booking.

Integrity screen: new finding type PLAN_STAGE_MISSING (repairable:false) and counts.PLAN_STAGE_MISSING. SUMMARY_MISMATCH detail text may now read 'Stored ledger rows differ from the rebuild: row N field …'.

Notifications: new type HOLD_EXPIRED (staff bell for the holder, entity_type 'flat'). Other-charge demand bells now use entity_type 'booking_other_charge' with entity_id = the charge line id; the portal should route that entity type to its Demands screen (it falls back to Home today).
POST /payments can answer 201 with header Idempotent-Replayed: true even when the plugin's replay record is gone (same receipt). Clients should treat it exactly like a plugin replay.
platform: POST /api/v1/admin/jobs/:name/run: a duplicate while a manual run is queued, running or waiting for a retry is now race-free and returns 409 {error:{code:'JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING', details:{run_id}}}. 202 {run_id, job_id, job_name, status:'QUEUED', queued_at} is unchanged. The ERP jobs page should show 'already running' and link run_id.

POST /api/v1/exports: new 429 {error:{code:'RATE_LIMITED', details:{retry_after:60, limit:3}}} with Retry-After: 60 when the user already has 3 exports QUEUED or RUNNING. New 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (issues path 'path') when the path has '.' or '..' segments or ':param' syntax. New 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After when the queue is unreachable within 5 s. An export can now end FAILED with error '<path> cannot page its CSV export; …'; show the error text.

POST /api/v1/admin/backup: new 409 {error:{code:'JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING', details:{backup_id}}} while a backup for the company is QUEUED or RUNNING. 503 when the queue is unreachable. The ERP backups page should disable the button while one is in flight.

Integration and CORS: expose X-Export-Total, X-Export-Rows, X-Export-Truncated and X-Export-Next-Cursor in CORS exposedHeaders so the ERP can read the truncation flag on CSV downloads and offer POST /exports.

Reports track: change apps/api/src/modules/reports/common.ts reportPaging to `listPaging({ ...rest, ...(wantedFormat(q) === 'json' ? {} : { format: 'csv' as const }) }, q)` so report CSVs get X-Export-* headers and can be exported asynchronously past 10,000 rows.

Deploy track: add `GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA drizzle TO kkt_app; GRANT SELECT ON drizzle.__drizzle_migrations TO kkt_app;` to infra/postgres/init/01-roles.sql (after the migrations exist; the migrate job can re-grant). Without it, backups taken as kkt_app record schema.migrations_applied = null and restore skips its schema-version check. Apply packages/db/partitions/*.sql as kkt_owner, never as kkt_app.
ERROR_WEBHOOK_URL consumers: the job.failed payload now also has company_id (null for system-wide jobs).
deploy: Error envelope (additive): when tracing is on, error bodies may include `error.trace_id` (32-hex string) next to `error.request_id`, and every response may carry an `X-Trace-Id` header. ERP and portal error toasts and support screens should show request_id, and trace_id when present. Both headers are now in the CORS exposed headers.

Deprecated operations: every answer, including 401/403/429/503, carries `Deprecation: @<unix-seconds>`, `Sunset: <HTTP-date>` and `Link: </api/v1/docs>; rel="deprecation"; type="text/html"[, <successor>; rel="successor-version"]`. These are exposed via CORS. The portal (native builds stay on old versions) should show a non-blocking 'please update the app' notice when a response it relies on carries `Deprecation`. Retired operations answer 410 with `error.code = "GONE"` and `error.details = { sunset, replacement? }`; clients should show the message. No v1 operation is deprecated today.
No endpoint shapes changed. OpenAPI operations of deprecated routes gain an `x-sunset: YYYY-MM-DD` extension; generated clients can ignore it.
frontend: None for API endpoints or contracts: this review changed no endpoint or wire schema. The only API-side change is the build entry in apps/api/tsup.config.ts (pdfWorker.ts). The deploy and integration stage must keep that entry, and the image must keep shipping dejavu-fonts-ttf in the production node_modules (it already does, as a dependency).

Deploy: keep the web server unpublished and behind Caddy while its subnet is in the API's TRUST_PROXY (docker-compose.prod.yml uses uniquelocal), otherwise visitors can choose their own rate-limit bucket.

New design tokens other frontend work should use for form controls: ERP --color-border-input (#7c8aa0, Tailwind border-border-input / bg-border-input); web CONTROL field border navy-900/55 with gold-700 focus; portal colors.fieldBorder and colors.fieldBorderOnNavy. New form controls must use these, not border-strong / lineStrong / navy-900/15, or the per-app contrast tests fail.

Tests and runners added or changed: apps/erp/src/lib/__tests__/contrast.test.ts; apps/web/test/contrast.test.ts; apps/portal/test/contrast.test.ts; apps/portal/test/loginFailure.test.ts; new cases in apps/erp/src/components/ui/__tests__/a11y.test.tsx and apps/web/test/field-aria.test.tsx; two new tests in apps/api/test/unit/pdf-render.test.ts; docs/qa/web/browser-qa.cjs now checks 48 px. Results: ERP 122/122, web 13/13, portal 8/8; API pdf-render, reports, reports-adversarial, security, conventions and seed 74/74 on kkt_h5 with Redis 20; acceptance 55/55 on kkt_h5_acc. Typecheck is green for erp, web, portal and api; ERP build, web next build and the portal expo web export are green. Every server I started (:4500, :3500, :8581, :5573) is stopped.
